map.美国 ABA 路由号码验证器。输入 9 位 ABA Routing Number: US ABA routing number verifier. Enter a 9-digit ABA Routing Number; it validates the check digit by a modulo-3 algorithm, for format verification of the financial-institution code in wire transfers and check processing.
map.依据美国 ABA 路由号规则，对 9 位号码按 3-7-1 权重分组求和后模 1: Per US ABA routing-number rules, sum the 9 digits with 3-7-1 weights per group then modulo-10 check; used for financial-institution code verification in wire transfers and check processing.
map.校验 9 位 ABA Routing Number 的 3-7-1 校验位: Validate the 9-digit ABA Routing Number's 3-7-1 check digit
map.转账、发工资或开支票前核对路由号是否录入笔误: Check whether the routing number was mis-entered before transfers, payroll or writing checks
map.解析前两位联邦储备分区号与对应城市: Parse the first two digits (Federal Reserve district) and the corresponding city
map.示例：路由号校验与分区识别: Example: routing-number validation and district identification
map.输入 011000015（标准测试路由号），3-7-1 加权和后显示通过，并解析: Enter 011000015 (a standard test routing number); after the 3-7-1 weighted sum it shows passed and parses district 01-Boston; changing any one digit reports validation failed.
map.9 位数字依次乘 3、7、1 循环，加权和须被 10 整除；这是 ABA 路由号: The 9 digits are multiplied by 3, 7, 1 cyclically; the weighted sum must be divisible by 10; this is the standard ABA routing-number check algorithm.
map.前两位代表什么？: What do the first two digits represent?
map.前两位是美联储分区号（01–12 及扩展），页面显示对应城市，可用于判断路由号归: The first two digits are the Federal Reserve district number (01-12 and extensions); the page shows the corresponding city, useful to judge the routing number's region.
map.校验通过就一定能转账成功吗？: Does passing validation guarantee a successful transfer?
map.不一定。校验只保证格式正确，账户是否存在、是否支持该笔业务须由银行确认。: Not necessarily. Validation only ensures correct format; whether the account exists and supports the transaction must be confirmed by the bank.
